question: Consider a regular heptagon (polygon of 7 equal sides and equal angles) $ABCDEFG$. (a) Prove $\displaystyle\frac{1}{\sin\frac{\pi}{7}}=\frac{1}{\sin\frac{2\pi}{7}}+\frac{1}{\sin\frac{3\pi}{7}}$. (b) Using (a) or otherwise, show that $\displaystyle\frac{1}{AG}=\frac{1}{AF}+\frac{1}{AE}$. (See the figure appearing in the next page.)

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
